xpact.tier: finalized, assertions off, EiffelStudio 25.02.9.8723 Enterprise, MSVC x64, stock production build with /MAP

method.elapsed: One warm-up per engine and configuration, then five sequential alternating paired rounds. CSV rows are the stock harness mean ms/parse for that process. Report medians are across rounds.
method.samples: Benchmark main thread only, within the timed parse loop in a separate sampling executable. Each inclusive symbol is counted at most once per stack. OS, harness and unmapped frames are retained.
method.diagnostic_probe: Count-only production rebuild with four diagnostic prints at entry to decoded_latin1_input and immediately before the continue_prefix, parse_prefix, and final parse calls. Recorded in separate one-parse processes.
